purpose: Law-1 recall channel: low-confidence / manualReview items preserved VISIBLY rather than noise-filtered. These are not promoted into the deduped finding set, but they are not dropped -- each is routed for human / Tier-2 adjudication with its overlap to the kept findings noted. Source: patterns/pattern-matches.json manualReview[] (5 entries), preserved verbatim with cross-references added.

parked.summary: Internal proportional accounting totalBalanceOf = convertToAssets(balanceOf(this)) * principal / totalDeposited depends on the strategy's raw vault-share balance, which anyone can inflate by donating vault shares directly to the strategy. Classic first-depositor/inflation harm is largely neutralized (deposits are onlyAuthorizedClient, principal credited conservatively, a donation benefits existing holders rather than stealing). Flagged because the proportional metric and the external convert* are donation/manipulation-sensitive.
parked.parkReason: Likely not independently exploitable due to access control + conservative credit; routed for human/Tier-2 adjudication.
parked.overlapsKept: DEDUP-007 (convert* manipulation root cause) and DEDUP-001 (vault-rate proportional metric).

parked.summary: State mutated AFTER external calls in both deposit and withdraw flows (CEI violated). Same-contract reentry blocked by nonReentrant on all mutating entry points. Residual concern: token type is unrestricted, so a callback-bearing token could enable read-only reentrancy against totalBalanceOf/principalOf mid-swap for an integrating reader. emergencyWithdraw is onlyOwner and lacks nonReentrant but only transfers shares to owner.
parked.parkReason: Mitigated by nonReentrant for direct reentry; surfaced for read-only-reentrancy / non-standard-token review only.
parked.overlapsKept: DEDUP-009 (CEI violation, refuted exploitable under non-hooked-ERC20 model). This parked entry is the read-only-reentrancy lens of the same code path; kept parked because it depends on an out-of-trust-model hooked token.

parked.summary: _accrueSurplusShares and _distributeBuffer iterate over the full _authorizedClients set in a single skimSurplus call. The set is owner-managed and expected small (protocol contracts); CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute's loop is a fixed 11 iterations. If an owner authorizes a very large client set, skimSurplus could exceed the block gas limit (skim DoS). Mild owner footgun, not attacker-controllable.
parked.overlapsKept: DEDUP-012 (same skim-path loop, consolidated from STATIC-011/023/024 at low/owner-bounded). Parked entry retained as the pattern-db corroboration.

parked.summary: totalWithdrawal caches the balance at Phase 1 and passes it to _totalWithdraw at Phase 2, but ERC4626Market._totalWithdraw IGNORES the cached amount for the economic computation (recomputes sharesToSell from CURRENT state and zeroes the client; cached value only gates require(amount>0)). The 24h/48h window protects the right-to-withdraw but the withdrawn value tracks live state, not the snapshot.
parked.parkReason: Likely benign (per-client zero-out is self-contained) but flagged so it is adjudicated rather than dropped.
parked.overlapsKept: DEDUP-010 (_totalWithdraw state-inconsistency / cached-vs-live, consolidated at low). Parked entry retained as the pattern-db corroboration of the cached-amount-is-decorative observation.

parked.summary: Reviewed approval handling. CurveAMMAdapter uses forceApprove(router, amountIn) reset-then-set each swap (USDT/approve-to-nonzero safe, no residual; Curve exchange consumes exactly amountIn). Strategy uses safeIncreaseAllowance(ammAdapter, amount|sharesToSell); the adapter pulls exactly that amount, so net residual allowance is zero per call. No raw approve(nonzero->nonzero). NO FINDING.
parked.parkReason: Documented no-finding (pattern explicitly marked QA/known-issue in DB). Recorded so the check is visible rather than silently dropped.
parked.overlapsKept: none -- clean. Retained only for audit-trail completeness.
